durable_lessons: Fresh-writer isolation does not rescue a packet that already bundles multiple custody units into one movement.
Before dispatch, audit the semantic packet itself for preservation-unit serialization.
A local reader question should normally expose one governing semantic pressure, not every related warning or qualification.

When a packet contains a governing thought plus related safety details, keep the governing thought in the writer packet and route the details to safety custody unless the reader-facing thought independently earns them.
If a candidate faithfully serializes an overpacked packet, treat the failure as supervisor architecture error rather than adding more prohibitions to the writer.
